address: Horringer Rd, Bury St. Edmunds, IP29 5PH
bio: Spoil yourself to a luxurious Afternoon Tea at the Woodlands restaurant within Bannatyne Bury St Edmunds. Indulge in a selection of delicious sweet and savoury treats at this peaceful country retreat.  Afternoon Tea is served in the restaurant, lounge or outdoor area which is a peaceful oasis of calm providing diners with the ideal environment to unwind while enjoying the great British tradition in picturesque surroundings.  Their menu consists of quintessential features of the British ritual such as sandwiches, scones and cakes. Those feeling in a decadent mood can upgrade to include a glass of prosecco or a refreshing peach Bellini.  Situated in a grand Neo-Jacobean mansion and sensitively restored and extended to provide the contemporary gym and Spa facilities, once you turn into the tree lined drive you will soon realise Bannatyne Bury St Edmunds is much more than just a Health Club.
